description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kithkin Spellduster.
When Kithkin Spellduster dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kithkin Spellduster.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
